dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are visible along the mid-dorsal line. The most central 'O' shape displays a sharp, high-contrast dark perimeter transitioning to a light-grey interior. To its anterior, a large 'C' shape shows a serrated outer edge. A third, smaller 'O' structure on the lateral flank has a continuous, smooth dark boundary with a high-intensity center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of low-intensity (near-black) solid pixel clusters is observed on the upper cervical region and dispersed between the macro-annuli. These blobs are irregular in shape and lack internal tonal gradients, appearing as solid dark islands against the mottled grey background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary macro-annuli form an elongated scalene triangle. When the centroid of the largest dark blob on the upper neck is included, the resulting polygon is an irregular quadrilateral with the longest edge oriented along the longitudinal axis of the torso.
